newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cotton exports shrink to 20 tonnes for week.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cotton exports shrink to 20 tonnes for week.

text.p: Egypt's cotton exports declined sharply to 20 tonnes in the 19th week of the exporting season, the Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association (Alcotexa) said on Sunday.
"We expect the exports to fall as buyers receive their fill," an Alcotexa official told Reuters.

He did not say why the exports had fallen so sharply but added that Japanese firms had bought all 20 tonnes. Last week, Alcotexa, which coordinates prices and exports by private and state-owned firms, said it had sold 624 tonnes.
The accumulative total for cotton export commitments this season rises to 62,093 tonnes, Alcotexa said.
Egypt has said it expects to export between 125,000 and 150,000 tonnes of last year's harvest.
